source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on the SUT with the power button.
2. Power off the SUT with the power button.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
(Depends on project design)
1. Physical and WebUI Power button should be green when system booted.
2. Physical and WebUI Power button should be orange when system in standby.
3. Physical and WebUI Power button should flash in green 5~6 min when system power on and solid on green light after system booted.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands:
-- Front Panel Power Button: agent powers the SUT on/off via OOB IPMI; the front-panel Power LED color (green/orange) is visual and the physical button press is operator-only (agent only drives the power command).
ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" chassis power on 2>&1; sleep 5; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" chassis power status 2>&1
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the ipmitool power command result + `ipmitool power status` after on/off; the power-button LED color is operator-visual.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: power cycling the SUT - confirm the machine is dedicated before cycling.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL but substitutes IPMI for the physical button under test.

original_test_intent: Verify the physical front-panel power button transitions the SUT on and off and that physical/WebUI indications follow project-specific boot, standby and transition states.
original_method: An engineer presses the actual button and visually observes physical and WebUI colors/timing while system state is confirmed.
manual_activity: Physical button actuation and LED/WebUI visual correlation are the core acceptance and must be performed by an engineer; the agent may collect supporting OOB/OS logs.
safety_requirements: Confirm no mounted/in-use workload before power-off.
Do not substitute IPMI power control for the physical button function.
Maintain OOB recovery and protect credentials.
No automatic retry; preserve unexpected shutdown evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Collect host/BMC power state, boot/shutdown logs and timestamps around engineer button actions.
Do not press button, claim color observation or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Press physical button, observe physical/WebUI indications and timing.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: IPMI status is useful supporting evidence; IPMI power on is not an equivalent stimulus and is rejected as substitution.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep physical-button method and use read-only OOB state/log collection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical on/off, green/orange/flashing 5-6 minutes and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Timestamp each physical press, record LED/WebUI video and independently capture BMC/OS power-state transitions and clean shutdown/boot evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds independent state/timing evidence without replacing the button.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves the physical control and indications.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Project matrix and safe power plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power-off may interrupt or corrupt active workloads.

project_override_considerations: Project design controls colors/timing; record actual approved values and do not claim source defaults beyond them.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and project-dependent criteria are compatible; IPMI substitution exists only in historical DeepSeek output and is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Project values are inputs. The clear physical/visual core is MANUAL ONLY rather than BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains read-only status but rejects substitute stimulus.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassifies PACKAGE to MANUAL ONLY because physical button/LED are core acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies explicit no-substitution and verdict boundaries.

review_improvement: Keeps the function-under-test as the physical button and adds independent power-state evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: An IPMI command can reach the same end power state without exercising the front-panel switch, debounce, wiring or indicator path; therefore the engineer must perform the core action.
